speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: It is also used by private entities to issue notices in fulfilment of statutory requirements.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: The Gazette is published by the Government Printer on the authority of the Government or pursuant to statutory requirements.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: In a way, one can think of the Gazette as a "public noticeboard".

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Digitalisation has transformed the manner through which we publish, obtain and access information.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: The electronic Gazette was first created in 1998.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Today, it is published every working day, while the print Gazette is published only once a week.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: In other words, the electronic Gazette is published earlier and more frequently than the print Gazette.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: The electronic Gazette has become the main form of the Gazette used by most of us today.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Recognising the public's greater reliance on the electronic Gazette, the Government has been leveraging digital technology to improve and enhance the Gazette.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: The law must also move in tandem with the trend toward greater reliance on the electronic Gazette.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: This status is not accorded to the electronic Gazette.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Similar to the Gazette, revised legislation can be published both in print and electronically.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Hence, even as we make the electronic Gazette authoritative, we should also move in alignment to make electronic versions of revised legislation authoritative.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: We are also taking the opportunity to make related amendments to other aspects of the law relating to the Gazette.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Clause 2 replaces the current section 48 of the Interpretation Act 1965 with a new section 48.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: The key effect of the new section 48 is to accord authoritative status to the electronic Gazette in the following ways.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: This means that both print and electronic Gazettes need not be formally proved before they can be relied on in court.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Taken together, this means that, going forward, the electronic Gazette will be the authoritative version of the Gazette.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Users can therefore rely on the electronic Gazette with confidence.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Other existing provisions relating to the Gazette are also consolidated in the new section 48.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Clause 3 amends various sections of the Revised Editions of the Laws Act 1983.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: This is in line with what we are doing for the electronic Gazette.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: The amendments will also do away with the outdated requirement for revised legislation to be published in print before they can be published electronically.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: In addition, clause 3 will delete provisions and language that are peculiar to print versions of revised legislation or premised on the primacy of such printed versions.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Clause 4 amends various Acts to abolish the use of the Gazette as an instrument of statutory appointment.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Today, various Acts require that statutory appointments be made via Gazette notifications.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: However, the use of the Gazette in such a manner is inconsistent with its function as a public record.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Hence, clause 4 will amend the relevant Acts to cease the use of the Gazette to make statutory appointments.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Going forward, these statutory appointments will be made via other means, such as the issuance of an appointment letter.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Nonetheless, these statutory appointments are often of public interest.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Hence, clause 4 will generally impose requirements for these statutory appointments to be published in the Gazette.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: The new requirements are directory in nature and are not meant to affect the validity of the appointments.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Clause 5 makes amendments to various Acts where references are made to materials printed by the Government Printer.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: As these materials could be published electronically in the electronic Gazette as well, the references are amended accordingly.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Other consequential and related amendments are also made.

speaker: The Chairman
text: The citation year "2024" will be changed to "2025", as indicated in the Order Paper Supplement.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I suspend the Sitting and will take the Chair at 3.40 pm.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Sitting accordingly suspended at 3.19 pm until 3.40 pm.
